title: Copay Component of the Out-of-Network Visit Share by Financial Class
content:
For an Out-of-Network Referral (Referrals & Prior Authorizations), the copay in the out-of-network visit share follows the patient's Patient Financial Account:

- where the financial class collects copays at check-in and a specialist copay above zero is recorded, the copay is that specialist copay;
- where the financial class does not collect copays at check-in, the copay is nothing;
- otherwise the copay is the office-visit copay.

Whether copays are collected at check-in is a setting of the financial class; the specialist copay and the office-visit copay are the amounts recorded on the patient's own account, the office-visit copay being the primary care office-visit copay recorded there.

## Criteria sheet

| Class collects copays at check-in | Specialist copay above zero recorded | Copay in the share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the specialist copay |
| yes | no | the office-visit copay |
| no | yes | nothing |
| no | no | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical accounts)

- Class collects at check-in; specialist copay 55.00, office-visit copay 30.00: the copay is 55.00.
- Class collects at check-in; specialist copay 0.00, office-visit copay 30.00: the copay is 30.00.
- Class does not collect at check-in; specialist copay 55.00: the copay is nothing.
